findings.text: Every live prompt now files its asks twice in the same session.jsonl. Server/RefineQueue.mjs:175 runs `AskIndex.after_refine` whenever `p.session` is set, and PromptTasks always sets it (Servex/agents/PromptTasks.js:53). `after_refine` calls `make_tasks` (Server/AskIndex.mjs:176,193), which adds EVERY ask as a Task (questions and statements too) to the session's session.jsonl through `task_home`, then PromptTasks adds the task asks again as `waiting`. SessionTasks would show the duplicates plus question-tasks that have no Approve button, and module inbox lines get written as well. The test misses this because it stubs `refine` (Servex/agents/prompt-tasks.test.mjs:32). The simplest fix is to let one path file the tasks: either pass a flag so `one()` skips `make_tasks` for this caller, or drop PromptTasks' own add and have `make_tasks` write `state: "waiting"` for task-kind asks.

Part of the owner's ask was not built (process-system/session.jsonl:60): "upgradable to a project, movable to <module>/tasks/ on approval". core/Session/doc/prompt-tasks.md:26 lists both as "Not built yet". Approve only changes the state from waiting to running; nothing moves and nothing gets an owner.
The same ask said "Also check that asks kept as doc notes were actually written down". Nothing in the diff or the doc answers that check.

When line 1 of session.jsonl has no readable id, `session` falls back to `rec.rel` ("2026/10/22/session-xxxx", PromptTasks.js:53). `AskIndex.session_dir` then takes `"session-" + slice(0,8)` = "session-2026/10/" and runs mkdirSync on it (AskIndex.mjs:59), which leaves junk folders under ai/sessions/.

Proposals are written with `caller: "owner"` (PromptTasks.js:59), so a machine-made task is stamped `by: owner` in the record. A caller such as "prompt-tasks", with `from: "owner"` kept, would say what really wrote it.

`record_for` assumes the prompt's card folder and the session record share the same day and folder name. prompt-relay.mjs pins its card folder to the day the session started, but the folder can be renamed later ("until something … renames the folder", prompt-relay.mjs:105). After a rename the prompts go quiet with no error, because `run` returns `{ok:false}` and nobody reads it.
`seen` (PromptTasks.js:23) keeps growing for as long as Servex runs, and it is empty again after a restart. That is harmless today because only a new page_add fires the hook.

The page change was judged from the author's own shot, core/Session/doc/shots/session-tasks-1200.png, since this review was given no shots. The Tasks block reads clearly, says "2 waiting on you" and shows Approve / Not now beside each task. "Not now" saves a `reject` (SessionTasks.js:30), which stops the task for good, while the label suggests "later". The words should match: either "Reject", or a verb that snoozes.
The two page_tools.js tweaks (`r.to` guard at :536, skip `from === "owner"` at :546) are sensible side fixes, but neither has a test.

The task/prompt-tasks worktree has moved on since this diff: SessionTasks.js line 2 there now mentions "Make it a project". This review covers diff.patch only, and line numbers are those of the files after the diff.
